# starrocks_table (Data Source)

Reads metadata for a StarRocks table by parsing `SHOW CREATE TABLE`. Use `database.name` as the identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "starrocks_table" "example" {
  database = "my_database"
  name     = "my_table"
}

output "table_engine" {
  value = data.starrocks_table.example.engine
}

output "table_columns" {
  value = data.starrocks_table.example.columns
}

output "table_key_type" {
  value = data.starrocks_table.example.key_type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database` (String) The database that contains the table.
- `name` (String) The table name.

### Read-Only

- `columns` (Attributes List) Ordered list of column definitions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--columns))
- `comment` (String) Table-level comment.
- `distributed_by` (String) Distribution clause as reported by StarRocks.
- `engine` (String) Storage engine (e.g. `OLAP`).
- `key_columns` (List of String) Ordered list of key column names.
- `key_type` (String) Key type (e.g. `DUPLICATE KEY`, `PRIMARY KEY`).
- `properties` (Map of String) Table PROPERTIES as reported by StarRocks.

<a id="nestedatt--columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `columns`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Column comment.
- `default` (String) Default value, empty string if unset.
- `name` (String) Column name.
- `nullable` (Boolean) Whether the column allows NULL values.
- `type` (String) Column data type.
